extension.summary: Google Drive as a Kodi WebDAV source
extension.description:
GDrive Bridge serves your Google Drive (My Drive, Shared with me and Shared drives) to Kodi as a read-only WebDAV source on this device. Add dav://127.0.0.1:8765/ as a video source and Kodi browses, scans and plays it like any network share, with seeking and subtitles.
Set it up from any phone, tablet or computer: open the add-on, scan the QR code and follow the steps. It signs in with your own Google Cloud client, so nothing passes through anyone else's server.
extension.news: v0.3.6: settings show the detected network address (greyed out) above the override, and the setup page has the override field too. v0.3.5: the setup PIN is new each time you open Set up on phone or computer and works once (no fixed PIN any more). v0.3.4: menu items Check for updates and Reset GDrive Bridge; a copy installed from a zip shows how to turn on automatic updates. v0.3.3: add-on updates now install cleanly, including the ones Kodi installs at startup. v0.3.2: stops cleanly when Kodi asks (faster Kodi exit). v0.3.1: the setup QR code uses the device's current address, even if it changed while Kodi was running. Updates now come from the GDrive Bridge repository. v0.3.0: the setup page opens only when you choose "Set up on phone or computer" in Kodi (upgrades switch to this once; it can be set back to always on); needs Kodi 20 or later. v0.2.0: several Google accounts (one folder each), Starred, Search (add-on menu), iPhone HEIC photos shown as JPEG, and read-ahead so Kodi rarely waits on Google. See changelog.txt.
